terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Next.js 16 (Turbopack) dev server on http://localhost:3000. Supabase and session values are read from environment variables (Cloud Agent Secrets): NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, JWT_SECRET, PUBLIC_RT_ID, REGISTRATION_RT_ID. Without them the dev server still boots; public pages render a graceful zero-state and warga/admin login is disabled. Run production checks with `pnpm run build` (requires the Supabase env vars) and security suites with `pnpm run test:security:*`.
